## Subsystems

| Subsystem | Weight | Done | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Build system & toolchain | 4 | 100% | clang i686 + SDL3, ninja, one command |
| Asset pipeline (ROM symbols) | 4 | 100% | 61k symbols pinned to the ROM, 47 native relocations |
| GBA memory map & ROM loading | 4 | 100% | address space embedded in the PE image; NULL and out-of-range accesses emulate the GBA bus (port_biosfault.c) |
| BIOS services | 3 | 100% | CpuSet, CpuFastSet, LZ77, BgAffineSet, Sqrt, reset |
| DMA controller | 3 | 100% | immediate, VBlank, HBlank with register latching |
| Interrupts & frame timing | 4 | 100% | exact 59.7275 Hz pacing, one game update per VBlank (verified against BizHawk); FPS and logic-rate readout |
| PPU renderer | 10 | 97% | modes 0-5, affine, windows, blending, mosaic, OBJ window; HUD layer follows GBA priorities (message windows stay in front); affine BGs now take the mosaic (the battle card-break effect pixelates the arena as on the GBA); reviewed against the hardware rules: window priority (WIN0 > WIN1 > OBJ window > outside), semi-transparent OBJ blending regardless of the window's effect bit, backdrop as second target |
| Input (keyboard / gamepad) | 3 | 100% | remappable keyboard (two keys per action) and gamepad buttons in kh_com.ini and the launcher; one-button dodge roll and stock (L+R); right stick changes and stocks cards; optional return-stocked-cards button (hold V / right stick) |
| m4a sequencer & mixer | 8 | 96% | full C port of m4a_1.s, 4x oversampled mixing; song loops checked against the ROM's sequence data; compared with BizHawk over boot and title: sample correlation 0.90, 4 ppm drift, port 3.5 dB quieter (overall output gain, the same on movies) and without the stepped-PCM images above 3 kHz; 4 minutes of title music hold the same figures |
| PSG (CGB) channels | 3 | 90% | square+sweep (band-limited), wave, noise, envelopes, length, NR50-52 routing; 79 songs/effects use CGB voices (KHCOM_SONG plays one); one wave RAM bank, as m4a's bank switching within a frame produces the same result; hardware recording comparison pending |
| PCM streaming (FIFO) | 2 | 100% | FIFO A/B fed by the DMA aimed at them, each at its own timer's rate; movie audio identical before/after, rate exact; castle movie compared with BizHawk (port/tools/audio_compare.py): sample correlation 0.99, flat -3.5 dB in every band (the port's overall gain) |
| Block audio codec transform | 1 | 100% | transform.s in C |
| Movie (FMV) decoder | 6 | 100% | native C; all 3605 video frames and 3604 audio blocks match ARM; all five movies play to their last frame and hand over to the next scene (castle, Larxene, Destiny Islands, staff roll) — KHCOM_MOVIE |
| Save data (SRAM) | 3 | 100% | kh_com.sav (per version) next to the exe, atomic writes; quick save, restart and load verified; five save banks (kh_com_bank<n>.sav) chosen in the options or the launcher |
| Soft reset | 1 | 100% | A+B+Select+Start returns to the language select; game globals restored from a snapshot |
